name: Level_2 - Task_5
description:
Quantify how small isotropic and Cartesian z-direction strains change the highest positive Gamma-point phonon energy of bulk silicon using the supplied MACE-MP-0 model. Construct a periodic two-atom primitive diamond cell with lattice constant a = 5.43 Å, primitive vectors a/2 × (0, 1, 1), a/2 × (1, 0, 1), and a/2 × (1, 1, 0), and fractional atomic positions (0, 0, 0) and (0.25, 0.25, 0.25). These Cartesian axes coincide with the conventional cubic axes. Use natural isotope-averaged silicon masses and record their values.

Evaluate all 25 pairs of isotropic_strain and uniaxial_strain drawn from [-0.02, -0.01, 0.00, 0.01, 0.02]. Construct each strained structure from the same reference: first scale the complete cell and positions by 1 + isotropic_strain, then apply diag(1, 1, 1 + uniaxial_strain) in Cartesian coordinates to every cell vector and atomic position. Do not relax the structures. For each pair, determine the largest finite, real, strictly positive Gamma-point phonon energy in eV.

Choose a suitable force-constant method and its numerical settings. Document displacement sizes where applicable, symmetry treatment, acoustic-sum-rule treatment, and the conventions used to construct the mass-weighted dynamical matrix. Fit all 25 energies by unweighted ordinary least squares with an intercept: phonon_energy_eV = intercept_eV + isotropic_coefficient × isotropic_strain + uniaxial_coefficient × uniaxial_strain. Report both coefficients in eV per unit strain, the intercept in eV, and fit residuals.

Submit a manifest linking your results, reproducible scripts, settings, and structured JSON validation data. Retain evaluated structures, raw forces or analytical derivative outputs, force constants, all mode energies, and a strain-to-result mapping sufficient to reproduce and verify the calculation and fit.
submission_format:
Fill in the blank manifest below and submit its path inside the task workspace
(for example, output/manifest.json). Linked paths may be relative to the manifest.
Replace null, empty strings and arrays with your results, file paths and data;
repeat example records and replace <...> keys with your actual identifiers.
Fixed units and method names describe the illustrated format. Where the task
leaves a method open, choose and record your method. Retain raw evidence and
calculations for any alternative method; unsupported calculations require
independent review before a final score.
